digest.component_or_area: store event append and write seam
propositions: An agent session comment containing a full environment dump with seven live credentials was written to the store without screening, causing GitHub push protection to reject the shared tickets branch (GH013) and queue 153 commits local-only for all concurrent agents.
The store has no content screening at the write seam; _validate_event checks only envelope shape and event_type membership, never inspecting data payloads for secret patterns.
Multiple write paths bypass append_event including the reconciler's inbound_translate which directly calls finalize_event halves with untrusted Jira-sourced COMMENT/EDIT bodies.

A deterministic pure secret screen must be enforced at finalize_event (the single seam all four writers route through) to block events bearing high-confidence credential patterns before they land on disk.
On secret detection the write is refused with an auditable force override (--allow-secret-pattern=<reason>) rather than silently redacted, preserving append-only store semantics and caller control.

Secret values must not echo in refusal messages, logs, stderr, or on-disk events; SecretFinding carries only family/field/line metadata with no value field, and payload keys are redacted before path printing.
